none: PAS NLM-4F7647: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate, possibly of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust probably cuirassed. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing left with possibly a transverse sceptre or slanting standard. XI in right field. Reverse inscription: possibly PAX AVG. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 2.81gms, die axis: 12
